notes:
### Dorcel Recovery Route Stabilization

- During active Site/IPTV checks, a validated Dorcel shadow session is now used only as source-availability proof. Non-hourly recovery reopens the original locked check route instead of playing the child chunks.m3u8 directly, preventing the roughly -17-hour timestamp/timeline fault seen in v1.149.
- IPTV recovery reopens its PVR channel, while Site recovery reopens PVR_COM_SITE. If that route reopen fails, Adult TV Test does not fall back to a direct child-HLS play.

### Handoff Validation

- Non-hourly recovery handoffs now require a longer stable playback window plus sane Player.Time and A/V-sync before they are marked resumed. One bounded check-route timeline repair is available as a failsafe.
- Failed route opens clear pending handoff and recovery-lock state so later recoveries are not blocked by a half-started handoff.

### Important

- Normal SOURCE_WINDOW thresholds, live-delay behavior, shadow timing, planned hourly token handoff, Unlimited stop handling, log saving and power actions remain unchanged.
